description: Elected in 2024, Jackson entered the Nevada Legislature and immediately got to work, proving that leadership is not about titles… it’s about results. As a freshman legislator, he passed multiple impactful bills, including historic, first-in-the-nation legislation prohibiting artificial intelligence from replacing licensed therapists… protecting both patients and the integrity of mental health care.
